Merging straight to main skips the one check that catches what review's actually for — not a formality, it's how we catch bugs/regressions before they hit prod. "No time" isn't a reason to remove that safety net; it's a reason to get a fast reviewer, not zero reviewers.

I'm not merging it without review. If it's urgent, tag someone for a quick pass right now — I can ping Marcus or Priya if you want a fast turnaround.
